sec.t: ff.158.1 Prime numbers and how to hunt them
sec.p: Yes, I know. It isn't the 20th. And Futuro Fortissimo shouldn't be landing in your inbox today. It's the 21st. And 21 isn't even prime, if you want to be picky. But it's 3 times 7. And those two definitely are. Years ago, when I set off on the “path of science”, my cousin - an…
